title: Finite one-layer covering lifting over fixed stage targets
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F : J \to \mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be precoverages with finite uncurried covering arrow sets, preserved by every transition functor. Let $V$ be a cocone whose object and arrow cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits of sets. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on its vertex such that a presieve belongs to $Q$ exactly when it is the equality-transported cocone image of a stage covering presieve. Fix a stage $j_0$, a finite target index set $K$, stage targets $T_i$ for $i \in K$, and target equalities $V_{j_0}(T_i)=S_i$. For each $i$ let $f_{it}:X_{it}\to S_i$ be a finite indexed $Q$-cover. Then there exist a stage $j$, a transition $e:j_0\to j$, and arrows $a_{it}:A_{it}\to F(e)(T_i)$ such that each indexed presieve of $a_i$ is $P_j$-covering and each cocone image arrow equals $f_{it}$ as an object of the arrow category. No nested coverings are part of the data.

source.place: Tag 09YL, finite-diagram observation and verification of axiom (2); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YL

proof.text: For each requested covering family use hQ to obtain a covering stage presieve, finite by hfinite. Apply colimit_presieve_indexed_presentation to reindex this presieve over a successor of the fixed initial target. Its equality with the transported transition presieve and hcover show that this indexed family covers.

Choose these individual stages for all targets. IsFiltered.wideSpan of their transitions from j₀ gives one common stage with a single transition e from j₀. Map each indexed family to this stage. Presieve.map_ofArrows and hcover preserve its covering property. Functor.map_comp and the wide-span equations identify its target with F(e)(T₀ i); cocone naturality preserves all prescribed arrow images. The wide span handles the empty target index without a case distinction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL; S3 proof via finite presieve reindexing and IsFiltered.wideSpan

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_covering_families_at_stage
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X → Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (V : Cocone F) (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V)) (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : ∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
      ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X)
        (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
        S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)
    {κ : Type u} [Finite κ] (j₀ : J) (T₀ : κ → F.obj j₀)
    {S : κ → V.pt} (hT₀ : ∀ i, (V.ι.app j₀).toFunctor.obj (T₀ i) = S i)
    {τ : κ → Type u} [∀ i, Finite (τ i)] {X : ∀ i, τ i → V.pt}
    (f : ∀ i t, X i t ⟶ S i)
    (hf : ∀ i, Presieve.ofArrows (X i) (f i) ∈ Q (S i)) :
    ∃ (j : J) (e : j₀ ⟶ j) (A : ∀ i, τ i → F.obj j)
      (a : ∀ i t, A i t ⟶ (F.map e).toFunctor.obj (T₀ i)),
      (∀ i, Presieve.ofArrows (A i) (a i) ∈ P j ((F.map e).toFunctor.obj (T₀ i))) ∧
      (∀ i t, Arrow.mk ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.map (a i t)) = Arrow.mk (f i t))
